Cochlear dimensions of ZETA, run 19ac527c · pipeline v0.1.0 · QC pass_with_warnings

For specimen ZETA, the cochlear dimensions from pipeline run **19ac527c** (version 0.1.0) are:

| Dimension | Value | Published range [Zahara2019] | In range? |
|-----------|-------|------------------------------|-----------|
| Cochlear A | 8.97 mm | 8.17–9.33 mm | ✅ Yes |
| Cochlear B | 6.81 mm | 5.73–7.50 mm | ✅ Yes |
| Height | 4.36 mm | 2.80–3.72 mm | ❌ No |

**Only the height falls outside the published range.**

Cochlear A and B are within their reference ranges, but the height (4.36 mm) exceeds the upper limit of 3.72 mm. This is flagged as a QC warning (`pass_with_warnings`), not an error.

> Note: CochleaHub computes these dimensions using a landmark-free proxy—the oriented bounding box of the scala tympani—rather than the classical landmark-based method (round window to modiolar axis). A value outside the published range is a QC warning, not an error [S3].
